Please direct all specific study related question the principles investigator of the study. You can find their contact information on the informed consent page of the study. If you would like to file a complaint any study, please reach out to the institutional review board listed on the study informed consent. 

All studies on this page are approved and managed by the Faculty Research Ethics Committee (FREC) and University Research Ethics Committee (UREC) at the Wrexham University. 

If you are a participant at Wrexham University and participating on a Research Module study, please direct all existing questions to the appropriate module leader.


# Home Research - Wrexham University 

Here you will find all relevant PhD and Psychology Faculty member's research. All home studies for BSc and MSc are managed on the **Psychology Technician Moodle webpage**. Please contact at [Psychology Technicianns](mailto:psychology.technician@Wrexham.ac.uk) at Wrexham University to publish your study on that page. Any further questions then please reach out to them if you have any questions at: [psychology.technician@Wrexham.ac.uk](mailto:psychology.technician@wrexham.ac.uk)

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.study-status').forEach(badge => {
    const endDate = badge.getAttribute('data-end-date');
    if (today > endDate) {
      badge.textContent = 'Closed';
      badge.classList.add('bg-secondary');
    } else {
      badge.textContent = 'Active';
      badge.classList.add('bg-success');
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.study-btn').forEach(btn => {
    const endDate = btn.getAttribute('data-end-date');
    if (today > endDate) {
      btn.classList.add('disabled');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
      btn.removeAttribute('href');
      btn.innerHTML = 'Study Closed';
    }
  });
});
</script>
